name: Why is my commercial construction bid so different from other bids?

mainEntity.name: Why is my commercial construction bid so different from other bids?

acceptedAnswer.text: Different bids often reflect differences in scope, allowances, labor assumptions, materials, subcontractor pricing, and what is excluded. A low bid can look attractive, but it may leave out permit costs, finishes, coordination, or contingency items that appear later as change orders.
acceptedAnswer.description: Bid gaps usually come from scope differences, exclusions, allowances, and assumptions. Compare line items carefully so you know what is and is not included.
